root_causes.title: Stated requirement not written to the capture fields
root_causes.why: On the one substantive call the buyer stated a quantity ('Just one'), a specification ('hydraulic or automatic') and their name and city, and the agent acknowledged each — yet the final capture fields (quantity, quantity_unit, specifications, updated_buyer_name, updated_city_name) are empty. The agent's own audit_* variables recorded the same values, so the values were heard but not written to the lead.

root_causes.title: Agent announced a seller transfer before capturing the requirement
root_causes.why: At turn 5 the agent told the buyer it would transfer the call to another seller before the quantity, specification or location had been captured. The handover is supposed to fire only after the requirement is captured.

evidence.quote: ...the seller you were trying to reach is busy right now, so I'll transfer your call to one of IndiaMART's best sellers. To help them give you the best deal, could you tell me how many machines you were looking for?

root_causes.title: Product change not reflected in the captured product
root_causes.why: The call opened on PVC Pipe; the buyer asked for a paper plate making machine. The agent fired requested_another_product, but the final product_name variable still reads 'PVC Pipe' (Product Change Case).

evidence.quote: Yes, I am looking for a paper plate making machine.

root_causes.title: Buyer did not engage on 2 of 3 calls
root_causes.why: Two calls lasted ~11s: the agent greeted, the buyer said nothing, and the call ended. No buyer intent could be captured; these calls carry no quality signal.

evidence.quote: नमस्ते... क्या आप अभी भी कॉल पर हैं?

fixes.title: Write the stated quantity and specification to the capture fields before closing
fixes.note: The connector exposes only a state id for the prompt, not its text, so the before/after hunks are indicative placeholders to be confirmed against the live prompt before applying.
fixes.before: <end the call once the requirement has been discussed>
fixes.after: <end the call only after the buyer's stated quantity, unit, specification, name and city have been written to their capture fields>

blockers.title: No production traffic in the window
blockers.detail: The connector returns only 3 interactions for Vani_buyer_bot in 3–9 Oct (and none in the previous 60 days), all flagged is_debug_call=1 from the QA owner's own contact. This run reflects debug calls, not production quality.

blockers.title: Capture fields empty on debug calls
blockers.detail: quantity, quantity_unit, specifications, updated_buyer_name and updated_city_name are empty on the substantive call even though the audit_* variables recorded the same values. Debug calls may not persist capture fields, so the Fatal capture finding should be confirmed on production traffic.

blockers.title: Agent prompt text not exposed
blockers.detail: agents get returns only a state id for the prompt, so the exact before/after prompt hunks could not be copied; the fixes are indicative.
